# Brief

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `config.json` (under `ORC_DATA_DIR` when set, else under `~/.orc/`), else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/orchestration/brief.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/orchestration/brief.md` and follow it. On Claude Code, dispatch with `subagent_type: "<role>"` and the brief as the prompt. Pass `model:` only to override the tier for this one dispatch, such as `model: "sonnet"` for a Mid-tier refuter. Parallel builders get `isolation: "worktree"`. On the artifact backend a refuter cannot write the board, so its brief says `BOARD: none` (see the `board` skill); on a local board a refuter writes its own card, so its brief carries the `BOARD:` line.
